# Voice AI template package

This package contains the direct static page, machine-readable manifest, runnable-implementation handoff, and planned video and slide deliverables.

See [`template.json`](./template.json) for the complete business and technical metadata, relative GitHub Pages-safe paths, and expected asset status. Production MP4, PPTX, PDF, and WebP assets are intentionally pending; no fabricated binary placeholders are included.

See [`SPEC.md`](./SPEC.md) for the agreed caller journey, Teams Phone extensibility architecture, routing policy, handoff contract, and acceptance criteria for the runnable sample.
